name: ky-openapi-generator
description: Generate typed HTTP clients from OpenAPI specs using ky.js

scripts.gen:example: npm run build && node dist/cli.js example/petstore.openapi.json --output example/generated
scripts.gen:example:build: npm run build && node dist/cli.js example/petstore.openapi.json --output example/generated
scripts.gen:xpanel: npm run build && node dist/cli.js example/xpanel.openapi.json --output example/generated-xpanel
scripts.gen:all: npm run build && node dist/cli.js example/petstore.openapi.json --output example/generated && node dist/cli.js example/xpanel.openapi.json --output example/generated-xpanel
